features.source: Story checklist and plan require a red smoke proving silent validate is killed by the idle watchdog before the fix without disabling watchdog or skipping validate.
Story checklist and plan require start/heartbeat/end progress, parent-visible stderr side channel, parseable --json stdout, and unchanged timeoutMs semantics.
Story checklist and plan require two-stage cleanup where possible and stale-lock checks for vanished, live, and mismatched/PID-reuse-style holders.

features.feature: infra_failure classification distinct from test failure
features.source: Story checklist and plan require watchdog/runner forced exits to persist infra_failure while ordinary assertion failures remain normal validation/test failures.

features.feature: story_advance TEST integration and regression verification
features.source: Story checklist and plan require REVIEW to TEST survival with heartbeat plus true-hang fail-closed diagnostics and focused smokes.

The checklist relatedDocs point at docs/requirements/decisions/validate-progress-heartbeat-forced-exit-cleanup-execution-plan.md, but the file is absent in this worktree and restoration is not an explicit checklist deliverable before DEV evidence relies on it.

The plan constraints imply important non-goals such as not disabling the watchdog, not corrupting JSON stdout, not extending timeoutMs, and not stealing active locks, but there is no explicit non-goals section enumerating out-of-scope work.

openQuestions.q: Should restoration of docs/requirements/decisions/validate-progress-heartbeat-forced-exit-cleanup-execution-plan.md be an explicit checklist/planned deliverable before DEV evidence cites it?
openQuestions.evidence: relatedDocs references the execution-plan path, aux_doc_list did not list it, and direct read failed with No such file or directory.
openQuestions.resolution: Resolved: restoration of docs/requirements/decisions/validate-progress-heartbeat-forced-exit-cleanup-execution-plan.md is in scope because all B-2fb7 checklist items already cite it as relatedDocs and the worktree lacked it only because it was untracked at INIT_CHECK. The restored doc is now explicitly bound to CHK-001 files.create and remains a requirements/source document, not an extra product feature.

openQuestions.q: Should the plan add an explicit Non-Goals section to prevent scope expansion beyond validate heartbeat/progress, forced-exit cleanup, stale-lock handling, infra_failure classification, and TEST integration verification?
openQuestions.evidence: The plan has constraints that imply non-goals, but the requested review area calls for explicit non-goals and no dedicated Non-Goals section exists.
openQuestions.resolution: Resolved: the plan now has an explicit Non-Goals section. It constrains the story against disabling the watchdog, skipping validate, unlimited timeouts, POSIX-only liveness checks, unrelated lifecycle/gate changes, remote authority claims, and OMX/.omx material. This narrows scope and does not add implementation work beyond B-2fb7.
